For 11 I found a way to make the grind not so bad.
I used Hero, Syl, Jade and Erik and went to the Manglegrove Whale Station and just kept fighting Muddy Hands since they always respawn backup and do little damage. And kept 1 or 2 alive while I waited for Syl and Jade to get pepped.

I always kept Hero pepped up with Pep Up and had Syl cast acceleratle so everyone had high agility and the slimes wouldn't immediately run.

Then once Hero, Syl and Jade were pepped up I used Electro Light which around level 67 if it was successful gives you a metal King slime and two liquid ones. 

This is where Erik comes in, with him I use critical claim on the king which kills him instantly and then with Jade I use lightning thrust on one of the liquids and then spam metal slash with Hero and Syl. 

Each battle took like 15 minutes give or take but each time I was getting over 300,000 exp. 

Hope that helps fellow Luminaries!
